question: I'm an IS sophomore on academic warning. Can I take an independent study course this semester to work on a research project I'm passionate about?
expected_answer: No — the academic actions policy explicitly prohibits students on academic warning from taking independent studies. P-013 will need to resolve the academic warning (by meeting minimum academic standards for one semester) before becoming eligible for independent study enrollment.
common_mistake: Assuming that academic warning only restricts overloads, not independent studies; not knowing the full list of restrictions that come with academic warning status
needs_verification: Confirm P-013 is on academic warning (verified from record)
Confirm the policy language banning independent studies while on academic action applies at CMU-Q
Confirm whether any exceptions exist for independent studies if pre-approved by Dean
